Ambipom

Normal

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Ambipom is a Normal-type Long Tail Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 20.3 kg. It evolves from Aipom. Its highest base stat is Speed (115), with a base stat total of 482.
